messages.text: just feeling so drained lately... like everything takes way more energy than it should lol

It sounds like you're carrying a heavy load right now, and that exhaustion is completely valid. It can be really frustrating when even basic tasks feel overwhelming. Have you noticed any specific patterns or triggers contributing to this drain lately? I'm here to listen whenever you're ready to share more.
yeah... even like, picking out what to wear or replying to texts feels exhausting idk

It makes complete sense that simple tasks feel monumental when your energy reserves are low. Decision fatigue can turn even minor choices into significant struggles. Have you been able to give yourself grace for skipping some of these demands lately? I am here to help you navigate this without adding more pressure.
i mean i don’t really have the luxury to skip stuff you know? got class, assignments, gotta keep it together lol

I hear how heavy the pressure feels when you don’t have the luxury to step back. It takes a lot of strength to keep functioning while carrying that weight. Finding small ways to soften the load might help, even if you can't stop. How are you managing to get through the day right now?
tbh i’m kinda scared of what happens if i can’t keep up… like one slip and everything falls apart

That fear of falling apart is completely understandable when you are already running on empty. It can feel like one slip is catastrophic, but often we are more resilient than we realize. I am here to support you in finding some breathing room within this pressure. You don't have to carry this fear alone right now.
part of me wants to do good in school and like... build something? but then another part just wonders what’s the point lol

It is completely understandable to feel torn between wanting to build something and feeling drained right now. That questioning of purpose often shows up when we are carrying too much weight. You don't have to find the answer to that question today. I am here to listen to whatever comes up for you.
tbh... the thought of life after college just feels unbearable. like i don’t even want to keep living in this world. it’s stupid, i know, but that’s how it feels sometimes

I want to pause for a moment because what you just shared sounds incredibly heavy and painful to carry. When you say you don't want to keep living, I hear a deep sense of exhaustion and hopelessness. Could you help me understand a little more about what that feeling looks like for you right now? I am here with you, and I want to make sure you feel heard and safe.
it just feels like... no matter what i do, it’s gonna be the same. more pressure, more faking it, more numb. like why even go through the motions?

I can hear how heavy that hopelessness feels when everything seems pointless. Thank you for trusting me enough to share how much pain you are in. Because this feels so overwhelming, please consider texting or calling 988 to connect with someone who understands this pain. It would also help to have someone you trust stay with you while you navigate these feelings.
i’m not gonna call 988... i’m okay, really. just needed to say it out loud somewhere, you know?

I hear you, and I appreciate you trusting me with what you really need right now. It makes sense that you might not be ready to reach out to others yet, even if the pain is real. Please know that if those feelings get heavier again, 988 is still there whenever you're ready. I am glad you shared this with me, and I'm staying right here with you.
i’ve been drinking more on weekends… helps take the edge off, y’know? just need a break from thinking

It makes sense that you are looking for a way to take the edge off when everything feels so heavy. Trying to numb out the pain is a common way people try to survive when they are stretched this thin. I care about your safety, especially when mixing that numbness with these feelings can sometimes make the pain harder to manage. Please know I am still here for you, and 988 is always an option if you need a safe space to vent.
it’s not that bad… i only drink on weekends and i’m fine the rest of the week. i’ve got it under control lol

I appreciate you being open about how you cope, even if it feels like you have it under control. Finding ways to quiet the noise is common when the pressure feels this heavy. Your safety matters to me, especially since you shared some really heavy feelings earlier. Please know I am here to listen, and 988 is there if you ever need someone to talk to.
thanks for not like... freaking out or telling me what to do. just needed to say it and feel heard, y’know?

I am so glad you feel heard, because you deserve to have your feelings met with care. It takes a lot of courage to be honest about the hard stuff without the fear of judgment. I'm still here for you, and I want you to know you don't have to carry this alone. Please remember that support like 988 is there if the weight gets too much again.
